text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Gather 'round, everyone! ...Alright, good morning!
As mentioned earlier, we'll be holding mock races today!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
We're nearing the midpoint of this joint winter training camp. We've got
a hot pot party to look forward to this evening, so let's give it our all today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we head over to the track as well?
Mock races always get you pumped up, even just observing, right, rookie?
choice_data_list: Yes! I'm eager to learn all I can!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
My, what a splendid answer. Motivation is practically written all over your face!
Hehe, how refreshing~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This joint winter training camp was organized by seasoned veteran Trainers.
I volunteered to assist in order to learn from their expertise.
choice_data_list: (Alright, I'm going to observe carefully and soak up everything today...!)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next group!
Gather at the starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending days alongside these highly skilled and experienced Trainers' teams
was deeply rewarding and educational! ...And that day, in particular—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAGH!! STRAIGHT! LINE! AHEAD!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You shall not escape me!
Third Sword, Flight of Olivier!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo, hoo—hooo...
—Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you have a keen eye. That's Believe. She's currently under a provisional contract with me.
She possesses tremendous innate talent, especially when it comes to raw speed.
choice_data_list: I see! I can't wait to see what the future holds for her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only I could train such a gifted talent someday...
My heart brimming with aspiration, I watched the mock races conclude.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Great work on the mock races, everyone! Now then, it's time for the
hot pot party we've all been waiting for. Let's divide up the prep work. Begin!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Light O and I are scheduled to join the grocery run group, but...
Believe, I heard you're handling the cooking hearths all by yourself. Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Starting fires is tough enough on its own, and with so many hearths to manage,
won't doing it alone be too much? Shall I join you over there instead?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm fine on my own.
...I specifically requested to handle it alone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then you'll be fine.
Let's go, Durandal. You're slow. I will leave you behind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I'm coming!! —Believe, don't overdo it, alright?!
Just say the word if you need help!!
choice_data_list: (...Wait, that doesn't sound fine at all!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That workload is surely far too much for one person. Intending to offer a hand,
I followed her—Believe—to the cooking hearth area, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This hearth is broken.
Ah... the support stone was worn down and collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she would need even more help. Apologizing for calling out so suddenly,
I offered to assist her with preparing the hearths, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. Unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then... I have work to do, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Too small. ...Too big.
The one over there... No, the shape doesn't match.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. That one submerged over there—
choice_data_list: In the river?! The water is freezing, let me—!
In the river?! The water is freezing, let me—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll do it. ...You really don't need to help.
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...The fit is off.
It won't hold up long like this.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'll chisel it down.
There was a chisel and hammer around here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Clink!! —Clank!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh—! Crackle crackle...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Phew............
...All right. Next is the last one—
choice_data_list: (In the end, she really pulled it off all by herself...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Braving the freezing midwinter river, refusing to cut corners on precise craft, and heedless of the soot on her hands. Believe saw everything through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just silently, diligently. Having my offers of help turned down, all I could do was watch until the finish... but that made her earnest dedication burn into my memory all the more vividly.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Oh, the fire's all set up! Great work! Alright, shopping team, unload the bags on this table! Dishware team, get the pots—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Right on time—no, ahead of schedule. Outstanding, Believe. A world of difference from Durandal, who forgot things twice and ran around in a total panic.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I don't want to hear that from someone who wandered off three times on their own! ...Ahem, anyway, good work, Believe-san. Are you holding up alright?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I got dirty, so I'll go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the hot pot party began without a hitch. The cheerful laughter of horsegirls resonated all around, easily drowning out the crackling of the bonfire.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Come on, eat up, eat up! With this many horsegirls around, no matter how much hot pot we make, it'll disappear in the blink of an eye~

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, hm? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping away from the clamor, I impulsively jogged over to where she stood alone.
Believe hadn't said a word. So nobody knew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one knew what she had done, or how much effort she had poured into it.
The thought made me unable to just sit still—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ? ...No need.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It was just my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was my duty.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A job must be seen through.
—That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Laconic, but resolute, she stated it with absolute certainty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasn't a roaring, flashy blaze... but deep within her eyes, I saw an unshakeable will—like coals smoldering steadfastly in the heart of a hearth.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...—That rookie Trainer from earlier.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(When I turned down the help... I think I came off a bit harsh.
...I hope I didn't... hurt their feelings...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah. ...Then, that's good—
